items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: And then later on I had a chance to play a few times with Ray Bryant.

ctx.x: From then you knew that’s how you wanted to play the double bass.
From the trio. He introduced the drummer, Bill English, Jimmy Rowser on bass, and the piano player leading the trio was Ray Bryant.
What years was that? Do you remember? In the 70s?
